summary: Introduction to the Ansible-base 2.10 porting guide, covering changes from Ansible 2.9: many plugins and modules moved to collections on Galaxy, and ansible-base is meant for users wanting a small controlled set of collections while regular users should install ansible.
questions: Should I install ansible or ansible-base?
Why did modules disappear when moving from Ansible 2.9 to 2.10?
What does the ansible-base 2.10 porting guide cover?

answer_card.title: Ansible 2.9 → ansible-base 2.10 overview
answer_card.answer_md: ansible-base 2.10 moved many plugins/modules out into **collections** on Ansible Galaxy. ansible-base itself is only for people who want a small, controlled set of collections; **regular users should `pip install ansible`**, which bundles the collections. Read the porting guide alongside the ansible-base 2.10 changelog.
